title: Release envir 0.2.1
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_envir.html)
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] [`urlchecker::url_check()`](https://github.com/r-lib/urlchecker)
* [ ] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [ ] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [ ] `rhub::check_for_cran()`
* [ ] `revdepcheck::revdep_check(num_workers = 4)`
* [x] Update `cran-comments.md`

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('patch')`
* [x] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [x] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [x] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [ ] `usethis::use_dev_version()`

title: import_from fails on reexported objects
description: `import_from(purrr, set_names)` fails because set_names is reexported from rlang
